## Problem

What user or contributor problem does this change address?

## Change

What behavior, source, workflow, or interface changed?

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] No private, customer-confidential, credential, or non-redistributable material is included
- [ ] Durable guidance has one canonical owner
- [ ] Source-schema, CLI, skill, or compatibility impact is documented when applicable
- [ ] Interface changes were inspected with keyboard and representative viewport/state coverage when applicable

## Evidence

Link relevant issue, source, screenshots, or local artifacts when they are safe to share.

## Compatibility and privacy

What will existing workspace users need to know? What did you inspect to ensure the change does not expose or redistribute private or third-party material?
